text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 2.48 billion markka median forecast for forest industry group UPM-Kymmene Oy's January-August profit after financial items, before extraordinaries and tax.
The results are due on October 17 at 0800/0500 GMT.
In January-August 1995, UPM-Kymmene posted a 4.54 billion markka profit.

For UPM-Kymmene's full-year 1996 profit, seven of the 11 analysts polled gave a median forecast profit after financial items, before extraordinaries of 3.85 billion markka (mean 3.79 billion) in a 3.15-4.36 billion markka range.
The company's 1995 profit before extraordinary items and tax was 6.23 billion markka. @
The data was collected in the first two weeks of October.
Contributors to the survey were Aros Securities, AG Private Bankers, Aktia Bank, Alfred Berg, Carnegie, Enskilda, Evli Securities, Handelsbanken, Interbank, Merita and Opstock.
